title: Supervisor feedback from my Deutsche Bank team lead
meta: Sumit Bahl, Team Lead, Deutsche Bank · Microsoft Teams message, August 2026 (transcribed)
quote: Thank you for the kind note. It was a pleasure having you on the team this summer. … [Y]ou brought a great attitude, strong curiosity, and a willingness to jump into new challenges from day one. Another thing I liked about you was consistently asking thoughtful questions, taking ownership of your work, and you made meaningful contributions to the team.

You should be proud of what you accomplished this summer. The progress you made as an engineer, problem solver, and teammate was evident, and I have no doubt you’ll continue to do great things wherever your career takes you.
Thank you for all your hard work, and please stay in touch. Wishing you all the best in your final year and beyond.
quote_by: — Sumit Bahl, Team Lead, Deutsche Bank
